content_md:
Misc internet musings

- Would micropayments for customer reviews help with the spam review problem? (I.e. issues with Amazon, Google Maps and other reviews are from bot ish accounts.) 
- What would provide a way to solve the identity issues? Is part of the underlying problem really just that the core internet economy is based on advertising? I saw a presentation for a protocol at a recent symposium that was intriguing though was pretty high level and didn’t seem ready to test. I am interested in testing alternative approaches locally. Think global act local as they say.
